node.label: Bonded labour
node.summary: Release and rehabilitation of bonded labourers.

facts.text: Law: **Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976**. **Art. 23** bans forced labour.
facts.plain: Law: Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976. Art. 23 bans forced labour.

facts.text: The Court called identification, release and rehabilitation a 'continuing constitutional obligation'.
facts.plain: The Court called identification, release and rehabilitation a 'continuing constitutional obligation'.

facts.text: SC (Justices **Vikram Nath** and **Aparesh Kumar Singh**): aid to freed bonded labourers within **7 days**; verify complaints in 24 hours; release certificate in 24 hours; States to adopt the SOP within 6 months.
facts.plain: SC (Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh): aid to freed bonded labourers within 7 days; verify complaints in 24 hours; release certificate in 24 hours; States to adopt the SOP within 6 months.
